_comment: Scenes: .tscn and .tres are deliberately NOT denied. The sanitise and resources gate stages verify them, so they meet the same bar as everything else the agent owns. Read docs/SCENES.md before writing one.
The default game-building policy denies the protected gate, generated reference and rule files. Integrity still catches protected-file changes if this provider policy is bypassed.
Every public and legacy integrity-acceptance route is denied because re-baselining the manifest must be a human decision.
ARCHITECTURE.md is generated: run `kit architecture update` instead of editing it.
Kit-builder maintenance needs a separately reviewed provider permission change; the default game-building policy cannot distinguish personas.
project.godot is denied so the [debug] warnings block and [importer_defaults] cannot be quietly altered. After explicit approval, use `kit setup profile <name>` for import defaults.
